create_logger_for_experiment: create a Logger instance to write experiment stats to a CSV file in a log directory
log_stats_to_csv: log a dictionary of key-value stats with a tick number to the Logger CSV output
checkpoint_runner_state: save the runner state to a checkpoint file using the Logger checkpoint method
load_last_checkpoint_state: load the last saved checkpoint state from disk using the Logger load_last_checkpoint_state method
gather_git_and_slurm_metadata: gather git commit info and SLURM environment metadata using the gather_metadata function
